stories.title: Northflank security breach leads to abuse of customers' AI API keys
stories.summary: Cloud application hosting platform Northflank is warning customers to rotate all credentials and secrets stored on its platform after a security breach led to unauthorized use of customers' AI API keys.

stories.title: Attacker Relentlessly Scans for Credentials by Impersonating AI Bots
stories.summary: The threat actor lurked behind bots posing as agents from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and others to find exposed data.

stories.summary: The former Canadian environment minister, who helped shape the landmark 2022 Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, shared his positive assessment of the biodiversity conference that concluded on October 31 in Armenia.

stories.title: Romanians tackle the problem of online disinformation
stories.summary: The first round of the 2024 presidential election, which was ultimately annulled, exposed widespread online manipulation. Once primarily active in street protests, Romanian civil society is now heavily engaged in fighting misinformation on social media.

stories.title: Vacherot joins Federer and Djokovic as a Shanghai and Basel champion
stories.summary: The unseeded Monegasque beat eighth seed Jiri Lehecka 2-6, 6-3, 6-3 in Basel on Sunday, a year after his Shanghai triumph. He returns to the top 30, and Novak Djokovic awaits in Paris.

stories.title: Alcaraz wins Vienna Open to maintain perfect record
stories.summary: Carlos Alcaraz extends his winning run in ATP 500 events with a straight-set victory over Alex de Minaur at the Vienna Open.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
